known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.95.0 ### Installation method Other (please specify in "Steps to Reproduce") ### Area(s) with issue? General ### Steps to reproduce Download the relevant installer for your system of PowerToys 0.95.0 or attempt to update from within PowerToys itself. Ensure that you have gone into Microsoft/Windows Defender and enabled (On) Smart App Control (not Evaluation or Off). Then attempt to run the executable and it should produce the following errors in the centre of your main screen and notification area of your main screen. The executable will fail and you are unable to use or update PowerToys. ### ✔️ Expected Behavior To be able to install and/or update PowerToys version 0.95.0, and then use it. ### ❌ Actual Behavior Installer fails to load and errors out and Microsoft/Windows Defender notifies you that Smart App Control has blocked an incorrectly signed part of PowerToys's installation. You are unable to install or update PowerToys whilst also having the needed protections of Smart App Control. ### Additional Information Windows 11: Version 24H2, OS Build 26120.6780. .Net version: The latest/unknown. British English. User and/or System Installation. Run as administrator. ### Other Software Microsoft/Windows Defender (otherwise Not Applicable).
